input.summary: Extend Deliverable/software warranty to 12 months and services to 90 days; delete the post-period cut-off of correction and refund duties
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the conformance warranty to twelve (12) months for Deliverables and software and ninety (90) days for Services, and removed the sentence extinguishing Vendor's correction and refund obligations after the period, so the Section 19.4 remedy remains meaningful. A fifteen-day window is well below our position; if needed we can accept a 90-day software / 30-day services fallback, provided the remedy survives.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For twelve months after delivery, each Deliverable and any software provided under this Agreement will materially conform to its documentation, and for ninety days after performance the Services will conform to the warranties in Section 19.1. Vendor's correction, replacement, and refund obligations under Section 19.4 apply to any nonconformity Customer reports during the applicable warranty period.
